body:
Install and update Horizon with the [Horizon launcher](https://github.com/ludovic111/horizon/releases?q=launcher-v&expanded=true). If you already have it, it picks this version up by itself. Website: https://playhorizon.dev

### New
- **Horizon's own menus:** a new title screen, world list, options and pause menu in the launcher's style, over a live frozen landscape. The vanilla look is still available: Options → Interface → Menu style → Classic.
- **Graphics settings, Simple and Advanced:** presets (Performance, Balanced, Quality, Ultra), or every rendering, quality, display and performance setting, each with a short description and its cost, plus a performance overlay.
- **Much faster rendering:** for example, at render distance 8 over a village, 363 → 2,409 FPS on an RTX 4080. Render distance 32 still stutters in places.

### Fixed
- **No sound on Linux.**
- **Linux builds now run on ordinary distros** (Arch, Ubuntu, …), not just the machine they were built on.
- **Windows asked for a missing DLL:** the launcher no longer needs the Visual C++ runtime.
- **Memory growing near villages:** mobs were duplicated when chunks reloaded.
- **The frame rate dropping and staying low** in villages.
- **Preparing resources failed on Linux** with "Missing … java-objc-bridge" (#41). Mojang's republished 26.3 version file is accepted too.
- **The hand and held item looked wrong at high FOV.**
- **Missing swing animations** in Creative and Survival.

### Known
- Sprint-jumping has been reported as broken, but we couldn't reproduce it. If it happens to you, describe it in #horizon-bugs on Discord.
- Online-mode servers aren't supported; skins served over https show the default skin unless already cached.

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. You need your own copy of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3.
name: Horizon 2026.10.13.1: own menus, graphics settings, faster, many fixes

body:
Horizon is a Rust reimplementation of Minecraft Java Edition 26.3, checked against vanilla by differential harnesses.

**Vanilla parity: 100% of what the harnesses compare.** Every subsystem in the README's table now matches vanilla in all 281 harnesses. Parity is declared complete only after a from-scratch audit on Linux and macOS and launch checks on these packaged builds, which come next.

### What's new since 2026.10.12
- **Dedicated server:** `horizon-client --dedicated --nogui` runs a server vanilla clients can join (offline mode), with vanilla's server.properties, status ping, chat, recipes, advancements and command tree. LAN discovery matches vanilla.
- **Worlds from 1.8 onwards** open and are upgraded as vanilla does, superflat worlds included, along with old options.txt and creative hotbars.
- **Mob AI** matches vanilla tick by tick in 92 scenarios: villager breeding and gossip, the warden and the sculk shrieker summoning it, ghastlings, copper golems sorting chests.
- **Spawned mobs' gear and enchantments** match vanilla.
- **Screens:** the resource pack screen, the open chat (input, history, command suggestions), the recipe book (drawing, search, ingredient placement), the loom's banner preview, End gateway beams, and player-list heads drawn from players' skins.
- **Render distance 2** now loads.
- **macOS** gives vanilla's results in every harness.

### Known differences
Online-mode servers aren't supported; skins served over https show the default skin unless already cached; pack icons show the unknown-pack texture in game; the creative hotbar keys (C/X) aren't wired up; item tooltips lack attribute lines.

See PLAY.txt in each archive to prepare the game's resources from your own copy of Minecraft.
name: Horizon 2026.10.13: 100% of harnessed vanilla parity

body:
Horizon is a Rust rewrite of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3, checked against the game itself. **Java parity: 88%** (270 differential harnesses pass; see the README's Project status).

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. These builds contain no Minecraft code, assets or data: you need your own copy of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3, and the first start prepares the resources from it.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Linux x86-64 (glibc 2.39+: Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 40 or newer; Vulkan) | `horizon-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `horizon-macos-arm64.zip` |
| Windows x64 (Vulkan) | `horizon-windows-x64.zip` |

Each folder holds the game, the resource preparation tool and a `PLAY.txt` with the steps: Python 3.10+, JDK 25, your launcher's 26.3 install and the 26.3 server jar you download yourself, then `python3 tools/prepare_native_client.py --prepare --server-jar PATH` once, then run `horizon-client` from the folder. The macOS build is not notarized: right-click > Open the first time.

## What's new

- Mob AI matches vanilla, tick by tick in 72 scenarios, with villagers on a port of vanilla's brain.
- New mobs: the breeze and wind charges, the creaking and the creaking heart, the sniffer, the happy ghast and ghastlings, llamas and trader llamas, and the copper golem; the warden's model, animations and emissive layers.
- Raids and pillager patrols.
- Dispensers, crafters, the loom and the recipe book; containers spill their items when their block is replaced.
- Every command runs as vanilla, including /item modify, /spectate, /waypoint, /dialog and /place.
- Scoreboards and teams in gameplay, the player list, subtitles, every HUD overlay, block entity animations, and End portals and gateways with vanilla's shader.
- Worlds from 1.17 onwards are upgraded as vanilla does.
- Builds for Linux, macOS and Windows.

## Known gaps

The warden's brain and the sculk shrieker summoning it, villager breeding and gossip, spawned mob gear enchantments, the resource pack screen, a dedicated server mode, and worlds older than 1.17.


## Known issues

- With the render distance at 2 chunks, a world stays on "Loading terrain…". Use a render distance of 3 or more (Options > Video, or `--render-distance 12`).
name: Horizon 2026.10.12: 88% vanilla parity
